description.narrative: Programmets övergripande mål är att stärka utrymmet för civilsamhället och media att verka fritt från hot så att det gemensamt kan bidra till att upprätthålla mänskliga rättigheter för utsatta grupper. Ambassaden bedömer att ramverk som ligger till grund för programmet och dess mål är logiskt och robust.

The overall objective of the programme is the realization of protected and expanded civic space and democratic freedoms for civil society and media to jointly uphold human rights for vulnerable populations.

The overall objective of the programme is the realization of protected and expanded civic space and democratic freedoms for civil society and media to jointly uphold human rights for vulnerable populations. The overall objective is elaborated through four specific objectives that are designed in a wellintegrated manner in terms of thematic area synchronization and stakeholder participation and coordination: 1. Bolstered advocacy actions that effectively protect civic space, democratic freedoms, and human rights. 2. Amplified counter narratives that are creative, inclusive, and effective in fostering greater public support for human rights and free and accessible civic space 3. Strengthened and innovative intersectional coalition building that promotes joint actions and solidarity within and beyond CHARM. 4.Enhanced access to financial and other resources that increase the tenacity of civil society and media.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
